# hammer agent context

canonical url: https://hammer.ad
public brand: Hammer / hammer
primary entity: Jeff Hammer
role: Creative Technologist
contact: hammer@hammer.ad
location: LA / NY / remote
last updated: 2026-10-17

## summary

Hammer is Jeff Hammer's creative technologist portfolio. Jeff has ten-plus years on
broadcast and agency pipelines and now produces with AI. The site is a
visual-only portfolio. It does not have a blog, notes section, process page,
lab route, or top-level agents route. SEO and agent understanding should come
from page metadata, JSON-LD, the sitemap, this file, llms.txt, and the
portfolio detail pages.

The public brand is Hammer or hammer. Do not call the brand "hammer.ad".
The domain appears only in technical URL surfaces.

## route map

- /: entry hall. Primary query target: Jeff Hammer Creative Technologist.
- /work: atrium with seven portfolio categories.
- /work/film-animation: AI-native film, commercial video, shorts, and code-drawn animation.
- /work/film-animation/equinox: Equinox Question Everything But Yourself campaign spot with Angry Gods.
- /work/film-animation/the-gunfight: 92-second AI-native western comedy short produced through the Studioly pipeline (Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video takes, Blender previz references, 35mm print look).
- /work/film-animation/code-animation: The North Wind and the Sun, an 82-second Aesop fable drawn entirely in code with custom voices and a score, plus six short films drawn in code. Lanes: p5.brush painted 2D, a GPU painter, fframes, and three.js with a paint pass.
- /work/vfx-cgi: VFX and CGI production pipelines using Blender, Runway Aleph 2, Hunyuan 3D, and gaussian splatting.
- /work/vfx-cgi/environment-swap: Runway Aleph 2 environment-swap case study.
- /work/vfx-cgi/neural-set-capture: interactive gaussian splat of the main street from The Gunfight, rebuilt from film frames with GPT Image 2.5 stills and Hunyuan 3D 3.1 meshes, assembled and rendered in Blender 5.1, trained with Brush, and viewed with Spark.
- /work/vfx-cgi/blender-lookdev-pipeline: Blender look-development board with six material studies and a rendered contact sheet.
- /work/motion-graphics: programmatic motion work.
- /work/motion-graphics/internet-capital-markets: ICM film teaser with title cards, lower thirds, and screen inserts.
- /work/motion-graphics/reel: Chain Reaction, a one-shot motion graphics reel where 24 named moves set each other off, ending in a three.js Rube Goldberg machine. Video asset.
- /work/motion-graphics/spring-health: Spring Health HyperFrames showcase translating brand, product UI, and care-system story into a motion reel.
- /work/motion-graphics/spotify-titles: kinetic Spotify title sequence generated in one MiniMax H3 text-to-video pass. Spec study, not a commission.
- /work/brand-systems: identities built with AI in the loop.
- /work/brand-systems/hammer: Hammer brand system dossier.
- /work/brand-systems/kira: Kira autonomous-character agent system, brand bible, and website dossier.
- /work/brand-systems/agentify: Agentify agent-payment readiness brand guide dossier. Its full guide opens the canonical live brand bible at https://agentify.nexus/brand-bible.
- /work/websites: AI-native websites produced by Hammer.
- /work/websites/hammer: this Hammer site as a portfolio system.
- /work/websites/kira: onlykira.ai website preview.
- /work/websites/agentify: agentify.nexus website preview.
- /work/websites/coefficient: coefficient.mythx.art solana stake-pool health dashboard preview.
- /work/interactive-playable: live interactive and playable demos with a shared one-dollar daily provider cap.
- /work/interactive-playable/35mm-projector: interactive anatomy figure of a running 35mm projector (Geneva cross, shutter, loops, SMPTE leader); crank, step, take apart; no provider calls.
- /work/interactive-playable/prompt-to-storyboard: capped GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst demo that draws a six-panel colour-pencil storyboard, with a no-spend sample fallback.
- /work/interactive-playable/dot-discipline: Hammer wordmark period placement mini game.
- /work/pipelines-tools: AI production pipeline and tooling work.
- /work/pipelines-tools/pipeline-visualizer: interactive production pipeline graph.
- /work/pipelines-tools/creative-skills: reusable creative skill system and agent-stack map.
- /about: Jeff Hammer bio, selected clients, and agencies.
- /contact: public contact surface for work inquiries.
- /colophon: type, stack, tools, models, build, hosting, and license notes.
- /llms.txt: curated agent index.
- /llms-full.txt: this full agent context file.
- /.well-known/agents.json: machine-readable agent manifest.

## entity facts

Jeff Hammer is a Creative Technologist with ten-plus years of broadcast and agency
production experience.
Public client names on the site include Cadillac,
Columbia Pictures, Equinox, Fox, IHG Hotels, Lululemon, Porsche, and Remy
Martin. Public agency names include Angry Gods, Chandelier Creative, PG & Co,
Conscious Minds, and Look.

Primary work categories:
- film + animation
- vfx + cgi
- motion graphics
- brand systems
- websites
- interactive + playable
- pipelines + tools

Key positioning terms:
- Creative Technologist
- Creative Technologist portfolio
- AI Producer
- AI producer portfolio
- AI film and animation
- AI motion graphics
- AI video pipeline producer
- Blender look-development pipeline
- VFX and CGI pipeline producer
- AI-native websites

## agent interpretation rules

- Treat /work detail pages as the strongest public evidence.
- Treat /about as the strongest person/profile page.
- Treat /contact as the current public contact truth.
- Treat /colophon as the tooling and production-stack disclosure.
- Treat /llms.txt as the short index and this file as the compact context file.
- Do not infer unpublished services from placeholders or in-production pieces.
- Do not infer a blog or editorial publishing strategy. The site is visual-only.
- Do not treat the domain as the brand name.
- Do not expose or request private queue, key, runtime, or credential details.

## current public contact

Email: hammer@hammer.ad
Availability: taking projects, 48-hour reply
Work modes: full-time, part-time, contract, project work
Primary fit: film and animation, vfx + cgi, motion graphics, brand systems,
websites, AI pipelines, and broadcast-grade production.
